head: 4b6a69c216533908a817556268f6c1035d0b3716
classification_reasons: Spec is tight (numeric acceptance to 1e-9, both flagged concerns decided by the panel), but open question 1 (whether 0.001 is KuCoin's current base fee) is still carried forward to the owner.
Blast radius is small, but it touches a shared config file: pyproject.toml's [tool.setuptools] packages list. No test covers that entry; only the build verifier's wheel listing does.
All of app/backtest/ is new code. No pre-existing test covers it, only the new tests/test_backtest.py.
attempted: Intent: traced each intent rule to engine._simulate. The decision at row i is read as positions[row-1] and filled at opens[row]. Buy is cash*(1-fee)/open and sell is coins*open*(1-fee). Equity starts at 1.0. positions[last] never fills. An open position is closed at the last close with the fee and the last equity is overwritten. The summary metrics match the intent's definitions. Out-of-scope items (CLI, shorts, slippage, funding) are absent.

Spec Acceptance, item by item, against tests/test_backtest.py. buy-and-hold: (1-fee)^2*150/100 with fee 0.002. Two-trade example: trades, all 7 equity values and the summary pinned at abs=1e-9. Decision candle: close 110 vs next open 120, entry at 120, equity rows pinned. Gap: Datetime(ms,UTC) frame without 02:00, entry at the 03:00 open of 120. End-of-frame close: closed_at_end True, final equals 0.999^2*121/100 and 1+total_return. Last-row decision: no trade. Every R14 refusal is parametrised, including the non-numeric price dtype added at build. Default fee is 0.001, and a zero-trade run gives trade_count 0 with win_rate 0.0 together (panel #2). The tests use no stub, fixture or monkeypatch of app.data. All covered.

Plan Proof: all 19 test names listed under Proof exist in the diff's tests/test_backtest.py. The extra tests (bad position series, validate column read, max_drawdown and summarize units, refuse-before-calculating) are additive. The parametrised value lists include the plan's lists (positions: None, nan, 2, -1, 0.5, '1', True; fees: -0.01, 1, 1.5, nan, True, plus '0.001' and None).

Proof: test.log, build.log and lint.log carry the 'deferred to the runner' first line, which is the CI-session case and not missing proof. verifier.md (test phase) cites the runner's build-gate commands check on 1044038: 152 passed, compileall exit 0, ruff clean. It states that the source diff 1044038..HEAD outside changes/ is empty. The test-phase diff confirms no source file beyond the build's set. The verifier called app.backtest directly: worked example within 2.2e-16, the gap case, a frame built from app.data.schema.SCHEMA, fee boundaries, and each refusal with its literal message. The changed behaviour is exercised.

Hand recomputation: row 5 equity is 1.1976012*0.999*85/90 = 1.1299367322. Max drawdown is 1 - 1.07568647568108/1.1988 = 0.1026973009. The decision-candle row 2 value is 0.999^2/120*130, which matches sell coins*130*(1-fee). Time in market from held [0,1,1,0,0,1,0] is 3/7. All match the asserted values.

Tests vs bugs: an off-by-one (positions[row] instead of positions[row-1], or a fill at the decision row's close) changes the entry_time/entry_price asserts in the decision-candle, gap and two-trade tests. A missing end-of-frame fee fails the closed_at_end test. Marking equity at open instead of close fails the pinned curve. A wrong drawdown peak fails 0.1026973009. The tests could not pass with these bugs present.

Blast radius: app/data/ is unchanged, app.backtest imports nothing from it, and no existing module imports app.backtest. The only shared file is pyproject.toml (one list entry; the removed line matches main). The version stays 0.1.0. No guardrail file is in the diff. Risk-list hits: none, so no brief was written. CLAUDE.md is now outdated (one feature, no app/backtest/ line). A run cannot edit it, and plan.md names the exact lines and suggested text for the owner, as CLAUDE.md requires. This is not a reason to park the run.

Policies: security-baseline rule 2 is applied (strict schema on the frame, price dtype and values, positions and fee; bool and NaN refused). There is no I/O, logging, eval, pickle or numpy, and no new dependency. Public functions have type hints. The result types are frozen dataclasses, and BacktestInputError subclasses ValueError. Messages name the input, the first bad index or value and what is accepted (R15). Feature-type change: no test file on main is modified.
Skip markers: none. gate-build.json details.skip_markers is [], and the new test file has no skip or xfail.

Claims against today's code: pyproject.toml packages was ["app", "app.data"] (the diff's removed line). The plan's departures (the __all__ order, gathering trade dtypes from open_time instead of TRADE_SCHEMA) are written into plan.md in the diff. Nothing contradicted.

Edge probes in the code: a one-row frame skips the loop and gives equity [1.0], with the last-row decision unfilled. An entry on the last row is closed at the same row's close. A zero-trade frame keeps the open_time dtype via gather([]), which the test asserts. max_drawdown cannot divide by zero, because prices > 0 and fee < 1 keep the peak > 0. A numpy array of positions is refused by type(v) is int, consistent with the decided strictness and with the message telling the caller how to cast. Nothing breaks behaviour.
Drive: sdlc.yaml commands.drive is empty, so there is nothing to judge.
